items.evidence_quote: One day, a shepherd named Melos stood before him.
items.note: 牧人として暴君に正義を訴えています。

items.evidence_quote: Often, the ruler ordered executions without a fair trial.
items.note: 敵を恐れ、不公平な裁判なしに処刑する暴君として描かれています。

items.evidence_quote: His friend had trusted him enough to face death.
items.note: 友人は身代わりの人質となり、メロスを信頼しています。

items.evidence_quote: “You punish people before you know the truth,” Melos said. “That is not justice.”
items.note: メロスは暴君を非難し、死刑を言い渡されます。

items.evidence_quote: Melos had three days to go and return. If he did not come back, his friend would die.
items.note: 妹の結婚式へ行く三日間、友人が人質として残ります。

items.evidence_quote: He reached the river, but heavy rain had made the water wild.
items.note: 川の危険は描かれますが、結婚式へ向かう途中に置かれています。

items.evidence_quote: “I cannot do this,” he whispered. “Perhaps my friend is already dead.”
items.note: 疲れ果てたメロスは、友人を見捨てて諦めようとします。

items.evidence_quote: Then he remembered his friend’s calm face. His friend had trusted him enough to face death.
items.note: 友人の信頼と自分の約束を思い出して立ち直ります。

items.evidence_quote: At the city gate, the guards were leading his friend to the place of execution. Then Melos shouted, “Wait!”
items.note: 処刑が始まる直前に到着します。

items.evidence_quote: “You punish people before you know the truth,” Melos said. “That is not justice.” The ruler’s face became hard. “Then you will die.”
items.note: 暴君への非難が死刑宣告につながっています。

items.evidence_quote: “I will stay here in his place.”
items.note: 友人は自ら人質となり、戻らなければ命を失う約束を成り立たせます。
恐怖や外部の力ではなく、友人の信頼と自分の約束が再起の理由です。

items.evidence_quote: He had learned that trust and loyalty could be stronger than fear.
items.note: 二人の信頼と忠誠が友人を救い、暴君の心を動かします。

items.evidence_quote: He reached the river, but heavy rain had made the water wild.
items.note: 川の難所が結婚式の前に起き、帰路の出来事としての順序がずれています。

items.evidence_quote: “Free him,” he said. After that day, the ruler demanded fair trials.
items.note: 友人は救われ、二人の忠誠に動かされた ruler は変化します。

items.evidence_quote: He had learned that trust and loyalty could be stronger than fear.
items.note: 友人同士の信頼が暴君の恐れや不信を超えるという希望ある結末です。

items.evidence_quote: The sky was becoming bright. The time was almost finished.
items.note: 期限への緊張はありますが、日没ではなく空が明るくなる描写です。

items.evidence_quote: After that day, the ruler demanded fair trials.
items.note: 原作にない公正な裁判の制度改革が加わっていますが、物語の中心的な教訓は保たれています。
